_source: Deterministic parse of raw Telair PBX CSV exports (ExportCallRecords, InboundCalls_Detailed, CallQueue_Detailed per queue) via scripts/parse_call_logs.py, chained against assets/data/reports/2026-10-19/call-logs.json. Replaces this date's earlier PDF-text-extraction of this same file (committed under this date previously) now that the raw CSVs are available. Every figure from the earlier PDF extraction (summary, queueReport, grandTotal, patientServiceKpi, longestWaitPerQueue, inboundByStaff) matches this raw parse exactly, which is a clean independent confirmation of that earlier reading.
_summaryVsGrandTotalNote: This file's own summary (from the deduplicated InboundCalls_Detailed file: 329 total/277 accepted/52 missed) matches the PDF's own pie chart exactly — no gap this date, unlike 2026-10-19. The queue-level grandTotal below sums to 275 accepted/52 missed (327 total) — 2 short of the pie on the accepted side only — the same small pre-existing PDF-internal inconsistency seen on prior dates (its own queue-breakdown table doesn't sum to its own pie/cover total), not introduced here. inboundByStaff's own 14 names sum to exactly 277, matching the pie precisely.
_tenDayTrendNote: accepted/missed/answerRatePct/overallAvgWaitSec all chain-match 2026-10-19's own committed trend exactly at positions 0-8, with position 9 confirmed against this report's own pie chart (277/52/84%) and Call Answer Rate chart (84%) — fully clean, no divergence this date (unlike 2026-10-19's single-point wait-time anomaly, which has now rolled out of the window).
_queuesNote: accepted/missed/avgWaitSec for all four queues chain-match 2026-10-19's own committed data exactly at positions 0-8, and all three non-zero queues' accepted/missed/avgWaitSec at position 9 match the PDF's own queue breakdown and per-queue charts exactly (Appointments 163/21, 39 sec; General Enquiries 107/30, 61 sec; Canberra Vasectomy 5/1, 54 sec) — clean match, no queue-level gap this date.
_patientServiceKpiNote: All figures match the PDF's own Patient Service KPI panel and Longest Wait Per Queue table exactly (718 sec longest call at 12:22 PM by De Ang Renfree; 459 sec longest wait at 3:56 PM in General Enquiries, attributed to Pinky De Paz).
_staffCountNote: All 14 inboundByStaff names match the PDF's own printed Inbound Calls - All Staff table exactly on both calls and duration — clean match, no gap this date (calls sum to 277, matching the PDF's own pie chart exactly). This independently confirms the earlier PDF-extracted reading of this table was accurate.
_outboundDurationNote: outboundByStaff's own call counts match the PDF's own 13-name outbound staff table exactly for every name (16/13/13/12/7/7/6/5/2/1/1/1/1, summing to the confirmed 85-call total, which also matches this file's own summary.totalOutbound and the PDF's own 'Total Outbound Calls = 85 Calls' header exactly). Several per-agent durationMins values differ from the PDF's own printed minutes by 1-3 (e.g. Samantha Cooper 15 here vs 18 printed, Kiara Pfeffer 11 vs 14, De Ang Renfree 9 vs 12), consistent with each source rounding individual call durations to the nearest minute before summing in a slightly different way, not a data error; recorded verbatim rather than adjusted to match.

_outboundOtherExtensionsNote: Not available in the earlier PDF-only extraction of this date (that report printed only the one reception-team outbound page) — this raw parse adds it fresh: 156 calls across direct room/doctor/nurse extensions, on top of the 85 reception-team calls in summary.totalOutbound, for 241 total outbound calls across every extension today.
_outboundTenDayTrendNote: FLAG FOR USER REVIEW (eighth consecutive date with a divergence on this chart): positions 0-8 chain-match 2026-10-19's own committed trend exactly (320, 268, 200, 235, 172, 105, 160, 158, 219). Position 9 (241, today) is this file's own raw-CSV-derived all-extensions total (85 reception + 156 other), independently computed — not taken from the PDF's own chart, which instead prints 116 for today (a 125-call gap, the largest yet). With a genuine all-extensions figure available for comparison today (241) alongside the reception-only total (85), neither is close to what the PDF's own chart shows (116) — updating the working theory from 2026-10-19's note: this isn't simply 'the chart tracks reception only', it looks like a broader, still-unexplained fault specific to this one chart's own rendering. summary.totalOutbound (85, reception-only) remains independently confirmed via the PDF's own staff table and header.
